summary: 1,284 BGL lines matched 'TLB error' at level FATAL between 2005-06-01 and 2005-06-30; showing the 2 most relevant.
sql: SELECT id, ts, node, component, level, message, template_id, episode_id, midplane, alert_category FROM bgl_idx WHERE message @@ ts_phrase('TLB error') AND level @@ 'FATAL' AND ts @@ ts_between(TIMESTAMP '2005-06-01', TIMESTAMP '2005-06-30', true, true) ORDER BY BM25(bgl_idx.tableoid) DESC LIMIT 2
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM bgl_idx WHERE message @@ ts_phrase('TLB error') AND level @@ 'FATAL' AND ts @@ ts_between(TIMESTAMP '2005-06-01', TIMESTAMP '2005-06-30', true, true)
caveats: Sample of 2 of 1,284 matching lines; use count_by or recurring_problems for frequencies, not this sample.
